jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow — Intestinal Tissue Immunity, Epithelial Remodeling and IBD

salary.note: Posted annual base salary; verify in application

jobs.job_description: Study tissue immune–epithelial remodeling in IBD with human and mouse organoid models and single-cell methods.
jobs.why_good_match: Exceptional CD epithelium, organoid and scRNA alignment; adds immune/regenerative biology.
jobs.tailor: Lead with CD susceptibility–exposure model, organoids, stress phenotypes and scRNA.
jobs.immediate_action: Send CV, one-page letter and three references to PI.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Scholar — IBD, Microbiome and Multi-Omics

salary.note: Posted annual base salary; verify in application

jobs.job_description: Human Crohn’s/UC studies combining microbiome, metabolome, immune signals and multi-omics.
jobs.why_good_match: Connects controlled CD/FMT chip experiments to longitudinal clinical microbiome biology.
likely_gaps: Training grant prefers US citizens/permanent residents
jobs.tailor: Lead with CD/FMT chip, shotgun metagenomics, scRNA and mechanistic redox work.
jobs.immediate_action: Contact PI and clarify training-grant eligibility.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow — Enteric Neuroimmune–Microbiome and Motility
jobs.company: Stanford University / Palo Alto VA — Becker Lab

salary.note: Posted annual base salary; verify in application

jobs.job_description: Study gut-brain/gut-liver axes, ENS macrophages, motility and microbiota in human tissues and mouse models.
jobs.why_good_match: Motility–microbiota biology complements microfluidic motion-versus-flow research.
jobs.tailor: Connect controlled peristalsis and perfusion studies with neuroimmune regulation of intestinal motility.
jobs.immediate_action: Email PI; ask about human model and chip integration.
